in_hebrew.name: Jervis
in_hebrew.long_meaning: Jervis הוא שם נוצרי עם משמעות רוחנית עמוקה בתרבות הנצרות. Derived from the Old English name Gerwis, meaning 'spear-worthy' or 'servant of Jesus'. Jervis is a name of strong Christian heritage, evoking images of courage and devotion.

in_greek.name: Jervis
in_greek.meaning: Χριστιανικό όνομα που σημαίνει Jesus servant
in_greek.long_meaning: Jervis είναι ένα χριστιανικό όνομα με βαθιά πνευματική σημασία στον χριστιανικό πολιτισμό. Derived from the Old English name Gerwis, meaning 'spear-worthy' or 'servant of Jesus'. Jervis is a name of strong Christian heritage, evoking images of courage and devotion.

in_latin.name: Jervis
in_latin.meaning: Nomen Christianum quod significat Jesus servant
in_latin.long_meaning: Jervis est nomen Christianum cum profunda significatione spirituali in cultura Christiana. Derived from the Old English name Gerwis, meaning 'spear-worthy' or 'servant of Jesus'. Jervis is a name of strong Christian heritage, evoking images of courage and devotion.
